name: Coelacanth Energy Inc.
summary: Coelacanth Energy Inc., an oil and natural gas company, engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and production of oil and natural gas reserves in northeastern British Columbia, Canada. It also offers natural gas liquids. The company owns approximately 160,700 net acres of land located in the Two Rivers area of northeastern British Columbia. Coelacanth Energy Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
